title: Item
description: A list row — leading icon / avatar / image, title and description, meta on the right, actions — and ItemGroup, which stacks rows in a card with dividers.
when: Settings lists, files, members, notifications, linked records.

instead.need: Entities with images and status in a grid

a11y: A linked row is one link (the whole row is clickable through a stretched link); actions stay separate buttons; ItemGroup is a labelled section.
